title: Standalone qualification dossier (DEL-09-02 SQ-v0.2 §5; OUT-002; PROPOSED)
description: One dossier per identified App candidate. It indexes the three named scenarios (V4-EXM-10, V4-EXM-11 inside the same run, V4-EXM-12) and the two journeys (J1, J2) step by step; each step points to DEL-09-01 EXP result records, to the supplier feature cases it joins and to the stimuli declared before the run (R23-27), never copying them. Step states follow EXP §6.1; outcomes are EXP's (HOSTING §9.3 labels). Kept at DEL-09-02 Evidence/EXP/<candidate key>/SQ-dossier.json (EXP §8.4). Rules beyond the schema: SQ-R1…SQ-R17 in app/examination/sq_receiving/sq_dossier_rules.py.

case_definition.description: The case definition as bound to its fixtures before the run: steps, stimuli ST-1…ST-5, preconditions (R23-19, R23-27).

examination_opened.description: When the integration owner opened the examination of this named candidate: from then on every step is planned and gets an EXP record (R23-20).

package_record.description: DEL-01-06 package identity record, when the native steps ran on a package.

not_claimed.description: SQ-R5: all six must be listed.

handed_over.description: Handed to DEL-11-03 as qualification evidence (SQ-R8).

reported_as_independent.description: Reported as independently examined (SQ-R8; EXP §7 RV-2).

run_ref.description: The joined run. V4-EXM-11's must equal V4-EXM-10's (SQ-R2).

access_modes.description: The access modes run B is defined to exercise, each in the home the scope defines for it (the account home H-acct for the ChatGPT account, the dedicated local home H-omlx for the local model server), with the conversation assigned to each (SQ-R3). A declaration, not an observation: this field asserts nothing about what was observed on the candidate. A home, mode or conversation observed to differ on the candidate is recorded as the failed outcome of the M12 step that observed it, in that step's result record, never by altering this declaration.

kind.description: A declared access mode of run B.

home.description: The home the scope defines for this mode, as declared; an observed home that differs is a failed M12 step, not a changed value here.

conversation_ref.description: The conversation assigned to this mode, as declared; distinct for each mode.

outcome.description: Only once every counted step is recorded (SQ-R4).

basis.description: J1 and J2 only: the basis that follows from the operation facts on the journey's attempted steps (SQ-R13); a summary of those observations, not a separate declaration. agent_operated: any attempted step operated by an agent or through computer use, or in which an agent operated a control. person_observed: at least one attempted step, every attempted step operated by a person by their own hand through the App's shipped controls, and no control operated or explained by anyone else. not_established: otherwise (no step attempted yet, a person's step done not through the App's controls, or a control operated by another person or explained by anyone).

actor.description: A person or an agent, identified; an agent also by provider, model and the session or thread it ran in.

session.description: The session or thread the agent ran in.

operation.description: Who operated a J1 or J2 step and by what means, kept apart from what was done outside the App's controls, from what the App's window did not give, and from what the examination itself could not perceive or operate. Present on a recorded J1 or J2 step whose outcome shows an attempt (pass, fail, blocked, inconclusive) and absent on a not-run or unrecorded step (SQ-R12). Blocked means attempted and stopped by a stated precondition or dependency (DEL-09-01), so a blocked step carries the operation of whoever began the attempt, by the means that attempt used, even when it stopped before any control was operated; a step that no one began is not run. These are the examiner's observations of the step as it was carried out, not a plan; only identities are declarations, as the actor or the session that ran the agent states them.

means.description: The App's shipped controls by the person's own hand; the App's shipped controls through harness computer use; or not through the App's controls, which cannot pass (SQ-R14).

outside_controls.description: What was done outside the App's controls for this step, apart from the journey action; allowed for any operator. A passed step lists each kind its step map entry requires (SQ-R17).

interface_gaps.description: What the App's window did not give a user in this step: a term unexplained, a next action missing, a state unclear, an engineering record that had to be read. Empty when none. A step with any cannot pass (SQ-R15); it is an interface failure.

examination_limits.description: What the operator or its tool could not perceive or operate in this step: a native dialog the tool cannot see, a control it cannot press, focus lost to another window. Empty when none. A step with any cannot pass (SQ-R16); it is not an interface failure, so the step is blocked (stopped by it) or inconclusive (its evidence left insufficient), not failed on that ground alone. An operator that cannot tell whether the App or the examination fell short lists it here and records the step inconclusive.

interventions.description: Every intervention in the step by anyone other than its operator, with the role in which they acted (examiner, another agent, another person) and who they were (VER-009, VER-010). An agent that operated a control makes the journey agent-operated; anyone else who operated a control, or anyone who explained one, keeps it from being a person observed; an intervention of kind other changes no basis but stays listed (SQ-R13).

by.description: The role in which the actor intervened; an examiner may be a person or an agent.

state.description: EXP §6.1 case states. 'held' only for an input held by an unresolved owner matter, never for a held DAG arc.

counts.description: False for a step added beyond the scenario's own words (SQ §3.1 J-8R, J-9R); it is recorded and never aggregated.

file.description: The supplier's Design file name: case ids are file-qualified.

core_loop_element.description: DEL-11-03 REQ-001 element this step bears on.

v3_reference.description: App v3 JOURNEY_RESULTS reference for DEL-11-03's comparison; evidence only.
